_experiment.description: [seed 0] Width scaling — hidden layers widened from 10 to 200 neurons. Total prunable weights: 196*200 + 200*200 + 200*10 = 81200. At 500 steps, sparsity ratio will be very low (~0.6%), so consider increasing steps to 5000 for a meaningful curve. Dense baseline accuracy should be substantially higher than the narrow baseline, providing more room for the algorithm to preserve accuracy while pruning. Expect a very long flat region.
literature: Wang et al. 2020 (Lottery Ticket): winning tickets exist in overparameterised networks — wider networks should have more tickets and thus tolerate more pruning
Blalock et al. 2020 (survey): compression ratios in the literature are frequently not accompanied by measured latency improvements — this experiment establishes what sparsity ratio is achievable
